description: Change an existing transaction: its category, amount, date, payee, comment or account. Only the fields you pass are touched. Pass a single id or a list of ids to apply the same change to several transactions at once (handy for recategorizing). Ids come from list_transactions. Sync must be done first.

account.description: Move the transaction to another account (name or UUID). Not valid for transfers — use from_account/to_account there.

amount.description: New amount for an expense or income. For transfers use outcome_amount/income_amount instead.

category.description: New category name or UUID (or several). Pass an empty string or an empty array to remove the category.

comment.description: New comment. Pass an empty string to clear it.

date.description: New transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format

from_account.description: New source account of a transfer (name or UUID)

id.description: Transaction UUID, or a list of UUIDs to update together

income_amount.description: New amount credited to the destination account

outcome_amount.description: New amount debited from the source account

payee.description: New payee. Pass an empty string to clear it. The linked merchant is re-matched to the new payee.

to_account.description: New destination account of a transfer (name or UUID)

name: update_transaction
